categories.description: Generated context packets lag the canonical filesystem queue.
Queue items remain implemented or accepted but still parked at needs_review review gates.
Queue records disagree with their task-local records or review state.
A queue or report record references evidence that is absent from the filesystem.
A queue or protocol record references a required report that is absent.
Generated reports reflect an older task routing state than the accepted queue chain.
A generated knowledge page records a source hash that no longer matches the source file.
Protocol projection or validation reports disagree with their accepted protocol chain.
OKF knowledge explains protocol state differently from protocol or queue reports.
ReferenceID reports, locators, or OKF refs disagree.
EventRecord reports, event refs, or OKF event refs disagree.
A report or knowledge page claims an unimplemented capability.
A record marks capability acceptance without the required reviewed predecessor evidence.
A generated artifact could be mistaken for source truth if its boundary is not explicit.
The repository state or generated report set changed during reconciliation.
